title: DR rehearsal: lose a key → re-key → read-back survives on pre-loss anchors → the old key is dead
description:
## BLUF

@peter asked for this rehearsal on KS-532. **KS-532 is Done and was archived on 2026-08-04, so it rejects comments and nobody would see it** — @kamil.kreiser ruled 2026-08-07 that it gets a fresh ticket rather than a reopen. This is that ticket.

**It needs four steps, not three.** As @peter wrote it, the rehearsal **would pass today while leaving the compromised credential live** — which is the clearest possible illustration of Finding A ([KS-577](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-577)).

## Detail

**The rehearsal**

1. Anchor a document; record the proof.
2. Re-key the org — `register-connector` with `rotate: true`.
3. Confirm read-back survives on the pre-loss anchor using the **new** key. *(@peter's assertion — expected to hold.)*
4. **Confirm the OLD key no longer works.** *(Added. This is the step that fails today.)*

**Why step 4 matters.** Rotation currently mints without revoking ([KS-577](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-577)), so steps 1–3 would all pass on a credential that is still live and still valid with identical scopes. A rehearsal that stops at step 3 proves **read-back continuity only, not containment** — and would be reported as a successful DR rehearsal.

**Sequencing.** Steps 1–3 can be run before [KS-577](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-577) lands, but the result must be recorded as *continuity only*, explicitly not containment. Step 4 is blocked on [KS-577](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-577).

**Also worth folding in** (@peter's sequencing asks on KS-480): [PS-473](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/PS-473) first — a lost key is recoverable by rotation, a lost GUID mapping is not — and [PS-463](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/PS-463), which is the only detection a botched re-key would have under async anchoring.

**Done when:** all four steps pass on demo and the run is recorded here with its evidence.

Findings checked against* `develop` `c8ce65dca`*; Finding B confirmed live on the demo VM read-only.*
